newsitem.title: INDIA: Landmine explosion kills two in Kashmir.
newsitem.headline: Landmine explosion kills two in Kashmir.

text.p: A landmine blast triggered by suspected separatist guerrillas on Monday killed two civilians and wounded a police official in India's troubled Jammu and Kashmir state, police said.

"A landmine went off near Rajouri Kadal, when a police vehicle, on the way to raid a militant hideout, ran over it. Two civilians were killed and a police inspector was injured in the blast," a police spokesman said.
Rajouri Kadal is in Srinagar, the summer capital of Jammu and Kashmir.
More than a dozen militant groups are fighting for Kashmir's independence or merger with neighbouring Pakistan.

Police and hospitals say more than 20,000 people have died since a separatist revolt erupted in the Himalayan region in 1990. Separatists and the state's chief minister, Farooq Abdullah, say more than 50,000 have died.
